key: I can't go outside...
en: I can't go outside...
ja: 外に　出られない……

key: My boyfriend, he was walking, and the plants burst a fissure in the street...
en: My boyfriend, he was walking, and the plants burst a fissure in the street...
ja: 恋人が　歩いていたら　植物が　道路を　割ってしまって……

key: He fell down underneath the city...
en: He fell down underneath the city...
ja: 彼は　街の下へ　落ちてしまったの……

key: It's too much...
en: It's too much...
ja: もう　耐えられない……

key: My boyfriend has been missing forever...
en: My boyfriend has been missing forever...
ja: 恋人が　ずっと　行方不明なの……

key: He fell down underneath the city when everything went haywire before...
en: He fell down underneath the city when everything went haywire before...
ja: 前に　街中が　めちゃくちゃになったとき　街の下に　落ちてしまって……

key: It's been so long, but I couldn't possibly bring myself to move on.
en: It's been so long, but I couldn't possibly bring myself to move on.
ja: ずいぶん経つけど　どうしても　あきらめられない

key: He was so important to me...
en: He was so important to me...
ja: わたしには　かけがえのない人だった……

key: You're the one that found my boyfriend?
en: You're the one that found my boyfriend?
ja: 恋人を　見つけてくれたのは　あなた?

key: Oh goodness, I can't thank you enough!
en: Oh goodness, I can't thank you enough!
ja: ああ　なんてお礼を言えばいいか!

key: You saved his life and that's so amazing!
en: You saved his life and that's so amazing!
ja: 命を　助けてくれたのね　本当にすごいわ!

key: LOL, scared of plants.
en: LOL, scared of plants.
ja: ウケる　植物にビビってるとか

key: Noobs.
en: Noobs.
ja: ザコどもが

key: I pwnz you all, dood.
en: I pwnz you all, dood.
ja: オマエら全員　オレが瞬殺っす

key: Did you hear about that affair with the Daycare Couple?
en: Did you hear about that affair with the Daycare Couple?
ja: そだてやの夫婦の　あの一件　聞いた?

key: Apparently it was already resolved, but some Trainers got their Pokémon stolen.
en: Apparently it was already resolved, but some Trainers got their Pokémon stolen.
ja: もう解決したらしいけど　ポケモンを盗まれたトレーナーが　いたんだって

key: Of course, I'm sure it would be a huge ordeal to track them all down and rescue them...
en: Of course, I'm sure it would be a huge ordeal to track them all down and rescue them...
ja: もちろん　全部を追いかけて　助け出すのは　大変な仕事でしょうね……

key: Let alone getting them back to their original owners...
en: Let alone getting them back to their original owners...
ja: 元の持ち主に　返すとなれば　なおさら……

key: But I feel sure in my heart that whoever does that will receive a wonderful reward!
en: But I feel sure in my heart that whoever does that will receive a wonderful reward!
ja: でも　それをやりとげた人は　きっと　すばらしいごほうびをもらえる。そう信じているの!

key: They just have to!
en: They just have to!
ja: そうでなくちゃ　ね!

key: I have witnessed the signs... The stars align...
en: I have witnessed the signs... The stars align...
ja: わたしは　しるしを見た……　星が　並ぶ……

key: End of days.
en: End of days.
ja: 終わりの日だ

key: True, bright skies and starry eyes make a city seem both bright and alive.
en: True, bright skies and starry eyes make a city seem both bright and alive.
ja: たしかに　晴れた空と　輝く目は　街を明るく　生き生きと見せる

key: But make no mistake.
en: But make no mistake.
ja: だが　思いちがいをするな

key: The end is yet to come.
en: The end is yet to come.
ja: 終わりは　まだ　これからだ

key: The level of growth the plants display is unprecedented...
en: The level of growth the plants display is unprecedented...
ja: 植物の育ち方が　前例のないものだ……

key: Trees that burst right through the street? How is this happening?
en: Trees that burst right through the street? How is this happening?
ja: 道路を　突き破って生えた木? どうして　こんなことに?

key: There's no defeating these plants. They'll rip through buildings if they have to.
en: There's no defeating these plants. They'll rip through buildings if they have to.
ja: この植物には　勝てない。必要なら　建物さえ　突き破る

key: So the flora situation's iced, huh? There's more to it though, for sure.
en: So the flora situation's iced, huh? There's more to it though, for sure.
ja: 植物の騒ぎは　片づいたのか。だが　まだ裏がある　きっとな

key: Hey, you try out that new incubator over at the Day Care?
en: Hey, you try out that new incubator over at the Day Care?
ja: なあ　そだてやの　新しいふかそうち　試したか?

key: I think it's pretty great, myself.
en: I think it's pretty great, myself.
ja: オレは　かなりいいと思うぜ

key: Just wish it had been around before I hatched 5 boxes of 5 IV pseudos.............
en: Just wish it had been around before I hatched 5 boxes of 5 IV pseudos.............
ja: 600族を　5Vで　5ボックス分　かえす前に　欲しかったよ…………

key: Man.
en: Man.
ja: まったく

key: Next time someone asks me for some kind of password, I'm gonna make sure to tell them "earlyincu"!
en: Next time someone asks me for some kind of password, I'm gonna make sure to tell them "earlyincu"!
ja: 今度　パスワードを聞かれたら　絶対「earlyincu」って教えてやる!

key: That'll surely spare me the heartache!
en: That'll surely spare me the heartache!
ja: そうすりゃ　あの心の痛みを　味わわずに済む!

key: And the leg ache...
en: And the leg ache...
ja: 足の痛みもな……

key: The plants destroyed my house... What am I gonna do?
en: The plants destroyed my house... What am I gonna do?
ja: 植物に　家を　こわされた……　どうすりゃいいんだ?

key: Hey! You're the one who found me!
en: Hey! You're the one who found me!
ja: あっ! オレを見つけてくれた人だ!

key: Thanks so much for getting me out of the Railnet. I really thought I was gonna die down there.
en: Thanks so much for getting me out of the Railnet. I really thought I was gonna die down there.
ja: 地下鉄道網から　助け出してくれて　本当にありがとう。下で死ぬかと思ったよ

key: Man, look, I know it's not really anything, but I'd appreciate it if you took this Sticker from me. It's for the Obsidia Department Store.
en: Man, look, I know it's not really anything, but I'd appreciate it if you took this Sticker from me. It's for the Obsidia Department Store.
ja: 大したもんじゃないけど　このシールを　受け取ってくれると　うれしい。オブシディアデパートのやつだ

key: I guess they're kinda rare, right?
en: I guess they're kinda rare, right?
ja: まあ　けっこう　珍しいらしいぜ?

key: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Aron!
en: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Aron!
ja: \PNは　デパートのシール ココドラを　手に入れた!

key: Oh, don't you have a Membership Card? You should get one; that place is super cool to its members.
en: Oh, don't you have a Membership Card? You should get one; that place is super cool to its members.
ja: あれ　メンバーズカードを　持ってないのか? 作った方がいいぜ　あそこは　会員に　すごく良くしてくれる

key: Hey, if you do get one, come back here and I'll give you the Sticker.
en: Hey, if you do get one, come back here and I'll give you the Sticker.
ja: もし　手に入れたら　ここに戻ってこいよ　シールを渡すからさ

key: Hey! Aren't you \PN?
en: Hey! Aren't you \PN?
ja: やあ! きみ　\PNだろ?

key: I heard about you from the city.
en: I heard about you from the city.
ja: 街の人から　話を聞いたよ

key: I don't actually have any memory of what happened, but apparently I was found underneath the city when they were rebuilding the Railnet.
en: I don't actually have any memory of what happened, but apparently I was found underneath the city when they were rebuilding the Railnet.
ja: 何があったか　まったく覚えてないんだけど　地下鉄道網の再建中に　街の下で　見つかったらしいんだ

key: They said I was on the verge of death after being trapped down there for so long.
en: They said I was on the verge of death after being trapped down there for so long.
ja: あんなに長く　閉じこめられて　死ぬ寸前だったって

key: I can't believe nobody found me before...
en: I can't believe nobody found me before...
ja: それまで　誰にも　見つけてもらえなかったなんて……

key: But since you funded the Railnet's reconstruction, the crew found me and I was saved!
en: But since you funded the Railnet's reconstruction, the crew found me and I was saved!
ja: でも　きみが　地下鉄道網の再建に　お金を出してくれたから　作業員に見つけてもらえて　助かったんだ!

key: So you see, I owe my life to you.
en: So you see, I owe my life to you.
ja: つまり　命の恩人ってわけさ

key: It's small in comparison, but if it'll help, I want you to take this.
en: It's small in comparison, but if it'll help, I want you to take this.
ja: 比べものにならないけど　役に立つなら　これを受け取ってほしい

key: It's a Sticker for Obsidia's Department Store.
en: It's a Sticker for Obsidia's Department Store.
ja: オブシディアデパートの　シールだよ

key: I'll never forget your generosity.
en: I'll never forget your generosity.
ja: きみの　やさしさは　忘れない

key: Thanks again, man. I really owe you.
en: Thanks again, man. I really owe you.
ja: 本当に　ありがとう。恩に着るよ

key: I'm worried sick, I am-- excuse me!
en: I'm worried sick, I am-- excuse me!
ja: 心配で　どうにかなりそう――ちょっと　すみません!

key: You haven't seen a boy about yea high wandering around anywhere, have you? My poor son was separated from me and I--
en: You haven't seen a boy about yea high wandering around anywhere, have you? My poor son was separated from me and I--
ja: このくらいの背の男の子を　どこかで見ませんでした? 息子と　はぐれてしまって　わたし――

key: If anything were to happen to him, I don't know what I would do...
en: If anything were to happen to him, I don't know what I would do...
ja: あの子に　何かあったら　どうしていいか……

key: You have seen him!?
en: You have seen him!?
ja: 見たんですか!?

key: So that's where he is-- oh goodness! I'll go find him at once! Thank you!
en: So that's where he is-- oh goodness! I'll go find him at once! Thank you!
ja: そこにいるのね――ああ　よかった! すぐ　むかえに行きます! ありがとう!

key: You're a Trainer, correct? Here-- you should make use of this.
en: You're a Trainer, correct? Here-- you should make use of this.
ja: あなた　トレーナーよね? これを――役立ててちょうだい

key: In case you don't know, this will change your Pokémon's Ability!
en: In case you don't know, this will change your Pokémon's Ability!
ja: 知らないといけないから言うけど　これは　ポケモンのとくせいを　変えるものよ!

key: They don't make capsules in other places like they do in Reborn.
en: They don't make capsules in other places like they do in Reborn.
ja: リボーンほどの　カプセルは　よそでは　作れないの

key: The Ability Capsules here can even activate Hidden Abilities!
en: The Ability Capsules here can even activate Hidden Abilities!
ja: ここの　とくせいカプセルは　かくれとくせいまで　引き出せるのよ!

key: Anyway, I've got to go! Thank you so much!
en: Anyway, I've got to go! Thank you so much!
ja: それじゃ　もう行くわ! 本当に　ありがとう!
